openness.description: Openness to new experience, curiosity, imagination, and intellectual flexibility.
openness.higher_is: Higher values indicate a stronger presence of this trait.

conscientiousness.higher_is: Higher values indicate a stronger presence of this trait.

neuroticism.higher_is: Higher values indicate a stronger presence of this trait.
